sources.title: Most Common Last Names in Wales
sources.scope: Estimated surname bearer incidence in Wales; selected names from the Wales-only published ranking
sources.limitations: Third-party modeled distribution; not an official census or birth cohort; incidence not used as weights; independent licensing and compound-name review required before production.

sources.title: Forebears surname list — wales
sources.period: Forebears 2014 snapshot and historical 1881 census-derived list
sources.scope: Territorially grounded surnames from national or county published surname incidence rankings; 697 new distinct values retained. Counts used as evidence only and not copied into entries.
